name: Remote Access
description: A verified scrcpy server, started only for the lifetime of one remote-control session.

settings.label: Video bitrate
settings.help: More bitrate preserves detail while the screen moves, at the cost of more USB traffic and encoder work. Four megabits leaves ample headroom on USB 2.0.

settings.label: Maximum video size
settings.help: A smaller frame lowers encoder heat and client decode work; a larger one keeps fine text legible. 1080 is the useful balance for a phone screen.

settings.label: Maximum frame rate
settings.help: Higher frame rates make scrolling and pointer feedback smoother, but make the encoder wake more often and heat the unit faster.

settings.label: Turn the phone screen off
settings.help: Keeps an unattended panel from spending power, adding heat, and burning a static image into OLED while the remote stream remains visible.

settings.label: Show touch points
settings.help: Useful when demonstrating where remote input lands, but the marker obscures the pixels beneath it and appears in the captured video.
